# Projects

A collection of my bioinformatics, computational biology and programming projects.

## 🧬 FLT3-Conserve

**Status: In Progress**

A bioinformatics project exploring sequence conservation across species using Python and biological sequence analysis, with a focus on the **FLT3 gene**. This is the gene that mutates in a significant proportion of acute myeloid leukemia (AML) cases.

The project is helping me develop practical skills in sequence analysis, biological databases, Python and reproducible computational workflows.

**Focus:** Bioinformatics • Sequence Analysis • Python • Conservation Analysis

[View on GitHub](https://github.com/MuhdSuraj){.btn .btn-primary}
